final.paper_results: Rgs6 top up in IP (all three times), not in IN; Abca8a top down in IP and IN; Bdnf up in IP and IN; Calb2 up in IP only; shared IP/IN DEGs: 11d Mylk3 up, 18d Ttr up and Csmd3 down, 27d 36 shared (29 opposite direction)

design.reasoning: Paper compares running vs sedentary within each duration, separately for IP (adult-born neurons, the paper's focus) and IN (DG tissue) (S2.1.p2-p3, Fig 1E-F). Fraction is a stratum (different RNA populations); within a fraction one cell-means model over the six group x time cells pools the residual variance (12 samples, 6 df) while each contrast stays within one duration. Every arm has n = 2 pooled replicates, so all six contrasts are exploratory by the n < 3 rule; small n is not a stop. Time-course and interaction comparisons are not the paper's estimand and are not run.
